title: てをあげるのがこわかった (Te wo Ageru no ga Kowakatta)
description: Sora always knows the answer in class but is too scared to raise their hand. What if they're wrong? What if everyone laughs? With quiet encouragement from their teacher, Sora learns that a trembling hand raised in courage is worth more than a still hand kept in fear.
author: オリジナル
